in_marathi.name: Aninditha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aninditha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aninditha is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'ani' meaning 'unconquerable' and 'ditha' meaning 'abode' or 'seat'. This name signifies a person who is invincible and unconquerable, often evoking images of strength, courage, and resilience.
